analysis.source_context: 현재 Canary Conjuring locale에서 Controlling…과 ‘Conjuring is controlling the app preview. Your clicks are paused.’가 같은 상태 묶음으로 확인됩니다.
analysis.summary: Conjuring이 앱 미리보기를 직접 조작하는 동안 사용자의 클릭을 잠시 멈추는 제어 상태입니다.

analysis.when_it_appears: Conjuring이 앱 프로젝트의 미리보기 안에서 자동으로 클릭하거나 동작을 확인하는 동안 나타납니다.

analysis_en.detailed_summary: Controlling… is paired with an explicit notice that the user's clicks are paused, confirming a state where Conjuring operates the generated app preview without competing input. It is not an error saying that the app or all of Discord has frozen. The copy does not provide a separate timeout for the control state.
analysis_en.search_intent: A visitor likely searched for “Conjuring is controlling the app preview. Your clicks are paused.” to identify the Discord feature or state and understand why it appeared.
analysis_en.source_context: The current Canary Conjuring locale pairs Controlling… with “Conjuring is controlling the app preview. Your clicks are paused.” in the same state group.
analysis_en.summary: A control state shown while Conjuring is operating the app preview and temporarily pauses the user's clicks.
analysis_en.what_it_means: Only the user's preview clicks are temporarily paused to avoid conflicting with the automated preview work.
analysis_en.when_it_appears: Appears while Conjuring is clicking through or checking behavior inside an app-project preview.
